words.definition: to make something clearer or easier to understand
words.example: Could you clarify what you mean by 'final draft'?
words.exampleTranslation: 你能澄清一下「最終稿」是什麼意思嗎？

words.definition: a person who is in the same class as you at school
words.example: She reconnected with an old classmate at the industry conference.
words.exampleTranslation: 她在產業研討會上重新聯繫上一位老同學。

words.definition: to collect information from different sources and put it together
words.example: Please compile all the feedback into one summary document.
words.exampleTranslation: 請把所有意見彙整成一份總結文件。

words.definition: a change made to fix an error
words.example: A correction was issued after the report contained wrong figures.
words.exampleTranslation: 由於報告內含錯誤數字，公司發出了更正說明。

words.definition: to modify something to suit a particular person's or organization's needs
words.example: We can customize the software to match your company's workflow.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們可以將這套軟體客製化，配合貴公司的工作流程。

words.definition: to identify the nature of a problem by examining it
words.example: The technician diagnosed the issue as a faulty power supply.
words.exampleTranslation: 技術人員診斷出問題出在電源供應器故障。

words.definition: to stop producing, selling, or providing something
words.example: The company will discontinue the older model next quarter.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司下一季將停產舊型號。

words.definition: a machine that automatically washes dishes
words.example: The break room dishwasher needs to be repaired.
words.exampleTranslation: 休息室的洗碗機需要維修了。

words.definition: a long period of unusually low rainfall causing a water shortage
words.example: The drought has affected crop supply and pushed prices up.
words.exampleTranslation: 乾旱影響了作物供應，導致價格上漲。

words.definition: to reduce spending or use resources more carefully
words.example: The department economized by switching to digital invoices.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個部門透過改用電子發票來節省開支。

words.definition: the main dish of a meal
words.example: Guests can choose between three entrée options at the banquet.
words.exampleTranslation: 賓客可以在宴會上從三道主菜中選擇。

words.definition: a device that explodes to produce colorful light and sound, used for celebration
words.example: A firework display will close out the company's anniversary event.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司週年活動將以煙火表演作結。

words.definition: goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft
words.example: Freight costs have risen due to higher fuel prices.
words.exampleTranslation: 由於燃料價格上漲，貨運成本也隨之提高。

words.definition: to cook food in hot oil or fat
words.example: The new menu item is fried in a lighter, healthier oil.
words.exampleTranslation: 新菜單品項改用較健康清爽的油來油炸。

words.definition: a unit of measurement for liquid volume
words.example: The tank holds up to fifty gallons of cleaning solution.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個儲槽最多可裝五十加侖的清潔液。

words.definition: a person who takes care of a garden, often as a job
words.example: A gardener visits the office campus twice a week.
words.exampleTranslation: 園丁每週來辦公園區兩次。

words.definition: in a perfect or most desirable situation
words.example: Ideally, the report should be finished before Friday.
words.exampleTranslation: 理想上，這份報告應該在週五前完成。

words.definition: including everything or everyone; not excluding any group
words.example: The price is inclusive of tax and service charges.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個價格已包含稅金與服務費。

words.definition: not enough for a particular purpose
words.example: The application was rejected due to insufficient documentation.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份申請因為文件不足而被拒絕。

words.definition: serving as an introduction; presented at the beginning
words.example: New members get an introductory discount on their first purchase.
words.exampleTranslation: 新會員首次購物可享入門優惠折扣。
